page_title: POL 0-2 ARG | Poland v Argentina 30/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Danny Makkelie has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) makes a rough challenge and Danny Makkelie blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' There's an opportunity for Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+3' Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' 0:13 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
86' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
83' Here's the change. Alexis Mac Allister leaves the pitch and Thiago Almada (Argentina) comes on as a substitute.
83' Substitution. Grzegorz Krychowiak did his best and is replaced by Krzysztof Piatek (Poland).
79' Substitution. Julian Alvarez makes his way off the pitch and Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) comes on as his replacement.
79' Lionel Scaloni has decided to substitute Enzo Fernandez and he is replaced by German Pezzella (Argentina).
78' Danny Makkelie shows a yellow card to Grzegorz Krychowiak (Poland) for a tough tackle.
77' The attendance for today's match is 44089.
73' Golden chance! Julian Alvarez (Argentina) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
72' Artur Jedrzejczyk (Poland) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bartosz Bereszynski.
71' Lionel Messi (Argentina) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Wojciech Szczesny.
67' 0 - 2 Julian Alvarez (Argentina) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
66' Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball has crossed the sideline. Argentina are taking a throw-in.
64' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lionel Messi (Argentina).
64' A great run by Lionel Messi (Argentina) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Argentina are awarded a corner kick.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Damian Szymanski (Poland) replaces Krystian Bielik.

61' Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Wojciech Szczesny makes a great save.
59' Here is a change. Marcos Acuna is going off and Lionel Scaloni gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina).
59' A substitution has been made. Angel Di Maria is replaced by Leandro Paredes (Argentina).
56' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
53' Lionel Messi (Argentina) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post.

50' Kamil Glik (Poland) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Danny Makkelie shows a yellow card to Marcos Acuna (Argentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

46' 0 - 1 Sensational! Alexis Mac Allister (Argentina) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the bottom of the left post and into the net. The assist goes to Nahuel Molina and the score changes to 0:1.
46' Czeslaw Michniewicz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jakub Kaminski (Poland) replacing Przemyslaw Frankowski.
46' Today's match ends for Karol Swiderski who will be replaced by Michal Skoras (Poland).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
45+2' Lionel Messi (Argentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny made a easy save.
43' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
41' Lionel Messi (Argentina) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
39' Argentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
39' Wojciech Szczesny dives to the left side of the goal and brilliantly saves the penalty taken by Lionel Messi (Argentina)!
38' Lionel Messi (Argentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
37' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
37' Referee Danny Makkelie makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Argentina. Let’s see what happens!
36' Lionel Messi (Argentina) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
36' Lionel Messi (Argentina) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.

36' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Wojciech Szczesny guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
35' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
35' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) takes a short corner kick.
33' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
33' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) launches a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny is alert to thwart the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Argentina.
31' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
29' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
29' Wow, what an escape. Julian Alvarez (Argentina) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
28' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) is able to continue to play.
27' Looks like Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
27' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' Referee Danny Makkelie sees the trip by Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Poland in a dangerous position.
24' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) works the corner short.

24' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Argentina will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
22' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
21' The ball is cleared after Matty Cash (Poland) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Poland as they win a corner.
21' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
19' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Wojciech Szczesny into a superb diving save to keep it out.
19' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
17' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
13' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
12' Wonderful pass from Angel Di Maria (Argentina) for Lionel Messi, but they can't profit from it as Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to collect.
12' Nahuel Molina (Argentina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is behind the touchline and Argentina will take a throw-in.
11' Lionel Messi (Argentina) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

11' Lionel Messi (Argentina) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Wojciech Szczesny allowed him to make a comfortable save. Argentina will take a corner kick.
10' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
8' Lionel Messi (Argentina) sends a long ball forward to Marcos Acuna, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Poland.

7' That didn't go as planned! Lionel Messi (Argentina) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Wojciech Szczesny, who easily kept it out.
7' An attempted cross from Marcos Acuna (Argentina) is cleared.
6' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Robert Lewandowski, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
5' That's unlucky! Krystian Bielik (Poland) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
4' Bartosz Bereszynski (Poland) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
3' Bartosz Bereszynski (Poland) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
2' The foul by Nicolas Otamendi (Argentina) was seen by Danny Makkelie who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
2' Lionel Messi (Argentina) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
2' Angel Di Maria (Argentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Argentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Poland will kick the game off.
Danny Makkelie will referee today's match.
